regions.region: page 7 upper-left Scheme 2 top and middle: 3bf to 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18
regions.finding: Five distinct synthetic-application arrows were inspected and merged into their existing records. Arrow-level equivalents/loadings, DMF or DME/H2O/DMSO, temperatures, 12/18/24/36 h times, Ar where printed, 65–89% yields, dr >20:1, and displayed Z/E values were retained separately.

regions.region: page 7 upper-left Scheme 2 bottom: 3am to cis-19 and E-3an to E-20
regions.finding: Two additional distinct arrows were merged into existing records: 3am with 3 equiv diethyl acetylenedicarboxylate/10 mol% Sc(OTf)3 at 100 °C for 24 h under Ar gives cis-19 in 55%; E-3an with 4 equiv NaOEt/DMSO at 40 °C for 30 h under Ar gives E-20 in 58% without isomerization.

regions.region: page 7 lower-left conclusions, Data availability, and author contributions
regions.finding: Conclusions summarize existing results and add no experiment. Data availability confirms CCDC 2014026 for 3cf; this is crystallographic characterization, not another preparation or an associated SI file. Author contributions add no experiment-specific run.

Jie Wang is thanked for reproducing 3ap, 3as, and 3am; these statements lack independent run details and were linked as provenance rather than duplicated. Yifan Cui provided 2s, also without a separable preparation. The acknowledgment says 3ap/3as are in Table 3 although the article places them in Table 4. Weiyi Wang provided 2l-prime with an ESI pointer, but no matching main-text preparation or associated SI file is available.

regions.region: page 7 right column references 1 and beginning of 2
